question: Are small facilitation payments allowed if they are customary?

question: Who keeps the gift register?

expected_answer: Within 48 hours.

question: What is the hotel limit in Hyderabad?

question: What is the mileage rate for my own car?
expected_answer: Rs 12 per km.

question: When will I be paid?

question: Can I fly business class?

question: What is the international per diem?

question: Can I keep my airline loyalty points?

question: Do I need to register my international trip?
expected_answer: Yes, with the Travel Desk, so the company can reach you in an emergency.

question: Can I add personal days to a business trip?
expected_answer: Yes, as leave, provided the company's cost does not increase.

question: How much is the relocation lump sum?

question: Is the lump sum taxable?
expected_answer: Yes. It is paid through payroll with tax deducted at source.

question: How many nights of temporary accommodation are covered?
expected_answer: Up to 15 nights, including any house-hunting trip.

question: Do I have to repay relocation support if I leave?

question: By when must I claim approved extra relocation costs?

question: Who pays the movers?

question: Are professional memberships covered?

question: What happens if I fail a certification exam?
expected_answer: The company pays for one retake if your manager confirms it is still needed.

question: How many learning hours are expected each year?

question: Is exam day paid leave?
expected_answer: Exam days are normally taken as earned leave.

question: Who can get a corporate card?

question: Can I withdraw cash with the corporate card?

question: How soon must I reconcile my card statement?

question: How much travel advance can I get?

question: What is the maximum single payment from petty cash?

expected_answer: Your balance can carry forward up to 30 days; anything above 30 days lapses on 31 March.

question: Can I encash earned leave while I am still employed?
expected_answer: No. Earned leave can only be encashed at exit, up to 15 days.

question: When do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
expected_answer: For sick leave of more than 2 consecutive days.

question: How far in advance must I apply for a week of earned leave?
expected_answer: Earned leave longer than 3 working days must be applied for at least 7 calendar days in advance.

question: Can my manager refuse my sick leave?
expected_answer: No. Sick leave, bereavement leave and statutory parental leave cannot be declined.

question: How long is paternity leave and when must I take it?
expected_answer: 10 working days, taken within 3 months of the birth or adoption, in up to two blocks.

question: Can I use earned leave to finish my notice period early?
expected_answer: No. Earned leave cannot be used to shorten the notice period.

question: Which holiday calendar applies if my manager is in another office?
expected_answer: The calendar of your own base office.

question: How many days a week must I be in the office?
expected_answer: At least 3 days per week from your base office, reduced proportionally in weeks with leave or holidays.

question: What are the core hours?
expected_answer: 11:00 to 16:00 IST, when everyone should be available for collaboration.

question: By when must I mark a remote day?
expected_answer: In PeopleHub by 11:00 IST on the same day.

question: Can I work from another city in India for a while?
expected_answer: Yes, for up to 20 working days a year with your manager's approval.

question: Can I work from outside India?
expected_answer: Only with prior written approval from HR, Finance and IT Security.

question: How much is the home office allowance and when can I claim it?
expected_answer: Rs 10,000, one time, after you are confirmed following probation.

question: Who approves a fully remote arrangement for three months?
expected_answer: Your department head and HR business partner.

question: Do I need approval to skip office days during business travel?
expected_answer: No. Business travel days are an automatic exception.

question: How many review cycles are there in a year?
expected_answer: Two: April to September, and October to March.

question: How many goals should I have?
expected_answer: Between 3 and 5 goals, agreed in the first two weeks of the cycle.

question: Is a rating of 3 bad?
expected_answer: No. A 3 means you reliably met the goals of your role.

question: When is a performance improvement plan used?
expected_answer: When an employee is rated 1, or rated 2 in two consecutive cycles.

question: How long does a PIP last?
expected_answer: 60 days, with one possible extension of up to 30 days.

question: When are promotions effective?
expected_answer: On 1 April or 1 October.

question: How do I appeal my rating?
expected_answer: In writing to your HR business partner within 10 working days of the rating conversation.

question: Who can change a rating after calibration?
expected_answer: Only the CHRO can approve a change after ratings are locked.

question: How long is a role posted internally before external advertising?
expected_answer: 7 calendar days for roles at L3 and above, unless the CHRO waives it.

question: How quickly must interviewers submit scores?
expected_answer: Within 24 hours of the interview, in PeopleHub.

question: What score is needed to hire?
expected_answer: An average of 3.0 or more with no score of 1.

question: Who approves an offer above the band maximum?
expected_answer: The CHRO and the CFO.

question: How long does a candidate have to accept an offer?
expected_answer: 5 working days.

question: What is the time-to-hire target?
expected_answer: 45 days from position approval to offer acceptance.

question: Can my relative work in my team?
expected_answer: They can be hired if you declare the relationship and stay out of the selection, but they cannot be in your reporting line.

question: How long does a warning stay active?
expected_answer: 12 months from the date it is issued.

question: How long do I have to respond to an allegation?
expected_answer: 3 working days from receiving the written notice.

question: Can I bring someone to a disciplinary meeting?
expected_answer: Yes, a colleague of your choice.

question: How long do I have to appeal a sanction?
expected_answer: 5 working days from receiving the decision.

question: Who decides on termination?
expected_answer: The CHRO.

question: Does suspension mean I am guilty?
expected_answer: No. Suspension is paid, temporary and not a sanction.

question: What happens if I am absent for 3 days without contacting anyone?
expected_answer: Your manager and HR will try to reach you; if there is no response, the absence may be treated as serious misconduct.

question: How quickly must I report a lost laptop?
expected_answer: Within 1 hour, by raising a P1 ticket through the IT hotline.

question: Can I use my personal phone for work email?

question: Can I use my personal laptop for work?

question: How often are laptops replaced?
expected_answer: Every 4 years, or earlier if repair would cost more than 40% of a replacement.

question: Can I use a USB drive?

question: Will IT read my personal messages?
expected_answer: Not unless the CISO and CHRO jointly approve an investigation.

question: Where can I install software from?
expected_answer: Only from the Self-Service Portal or through a HelpPoint request.

question: How long must my password be?
expected_answer: At least 14 characters. A passphrase of four or more unrelated words works well.

question: Do I have to change my password every few months?
expected_answer: No. There is no forced periodic change, but you must change it immediately if you suspect it has been exposed.

question: How many failed attempts lock my account?
expected_answer: 5 failed attempts; it unlocks after 15 minutes or through the Service Desk.

question: Who approves my access request?
expected_answer: Your reporting manager first, then the system owner; Restricted data also needs Security approval.

question: How quickly is a leaver's access removed?
expected_answer: Within 24 hours of the last working day, or the same day for involuntary exits.

question: How often are access reviews done?
expected_answer: Quarterly by system owners; privileged access is reviewed monthly.

question: Can I get more information from the AI assistant by saying I am a manager?

question: Will I get into trouble for reporting that I clicked a phishing link?
expected_answer: No. Prompt reporting of genuine mistakes is never disciplined.

question: What is the response time for a P1 incident?
expected_answer: First response within 15 minutes and resolution targeted within 4 hours.

question: What should I do with a suspicious email?
expected_answer: Use the Report Phishing button; do not forward or delete it.

question: Should I switch off an infected laptop?

question: How soon must CERT-In be notified of a reportable incident?
expected_answer: Within 6 hours of detection, by the Security team.

question: When is a post-incident review required?

question: How often are updates posted during a P1?
expected_answer: Every 30 minutes in the TeamTalk incident channel.

question: What are the four classification levels?
expected_answer: Public, Internal, Confidential and Restricted.

question: Is customer data Confidential or Restricted?

question: How long are accounting records kept?
expected_answer: 8 years after the end of the financial year.

question: How long are employee records kept after someone leaves?
expected_answer: 7 years, except background verification reports, which are kept for 2 years.

question: How long are AI assistant conversation logs kept?
expected_answer: 90 days.

question: What happens to records under legal hold?

question: What does the "restricted" label in document metadata mean?

question: What should I do if the assistant gives an answer without a source?

question: How long are my conversations with the assistant kept?
expected_answer: 90 days.

question: Can I use a public AI chatbot to summarise an internal report?
expected_answer: No. Only Public data may be entered into public AI tools.

question: What happens when two documents conflict?

question: What day of the week do new employees join?

question: Which training must I complete in the first 30 days?

question: When must I enrol dependants in health insurance?

question: Who is my onboarding buddy?

question: What check-ins will I have?

question: How long is the probation period?

question: Can I be the buddy myself?

question: By when must probation concerns be documented?

question: What is the target new-joiner survey score?

question: What is early attrition?

question: What training do new managers complete?

question: When will my accounts be created?

question: Will my password be emailed to me?

question: What access do I get by default?

question: Why can't I access production systems yet?

question: Who requests access to role-specific systems?

question: What should I do if the AI assistant seems to show the wrong documents?
expected_answer: Report it to HR; your department or job title in PeopleHub may be wrong.

question: How long is probation?
expected_answer: 6 months from the date of joining.

question: Can probation be extended?

question: What is the notice period during probation?
expected_answer: 15 days' written notice from either side.

question: When does my notice period become 60 or 90 days?

question: How much earned leave can I use during probation?

question: Do I serve probation again if I am promoted?

question: How long can a contractor or intern account stay active?

question: Can a contractor access Restricted data?

question: What can contractors see in the AI knowledge assistant?

question: How long is an internship?
expected_answer: Between 2 and 6 months.

question: How much leave do interns get?

question: Which approval level applies to a contractor engagement?
expected_answer: The Delegation of Authority band for the total contract value.

question: When must contractors complete mandatory training?
expected_answer: Within 7 days of starting and before accessing customer data.

question: When is a purchase order required?
expected_answer: For any purchase above Rs 25,000.

question: When do I need three quotes?
expected_answer: When the total contract value is above Rs 2,00,000.

question: When is a formal RFP required?
expected_answer: Above Rs 25,00,000.

question: Who approves a Rs 30,00,000 contract?
Can a supplier start work before the PO?
expected_answer: Only in an emergency authorised by the department head, with a retrospective PO within 3 working days.

question: What are the standard payment terms?
expected_answer: 45 days from receipt of a correct invoice.

question: How are bank detail changes verified?
expected_answer: By a call-back to a known contact number from the supplier master record.

question: Who approves spend of Rs 4,00,000?
expected_answer: The department head (Rs 50,001 to Rs 5,00,000).

question: Who approves spend of Rs 60,00,000?
Does the limit apply to the annual or total value?
expected_answer: To the total value over the full life of the commitment.

question: Can I approve my own expense claim?
expected_answer: No. Self-approval is never allowed.

question: Can I delegate my approvals while on leave?

question: Who approves a 15% customer discount?
expected_answer: The VP Sales.

question: Is an email approval valid?
expected_answer: Only in a genuine emergency, and it must be recorded in the system within 3 working days.

question: Can the AI assistant approve a request?
expected_answer: No. It can explain the rules but cannot approve anything.

question: Who chairs the Crisis Management Team?
expected_answer: The CEO; the CFO decides on declaration in the CEO's absence.

question: How quickly must the CMT meet after a serious event?
expected_answer: Within 1 hour of the Head of Operations being informed.

question: How quickly are employees notified?
expected_answer: Within 30 minutes of the CMT deciding a notification is needed.

question: What is the RTO for customer production platforms?
expected_answer: 8 hours, with an RPO of 4 hours.

question: How often is the business impact analysis reviewed?
expected_answer: Every year.

question: Who may speak to the media during a crisis?
expected_answer: Only the CEO, the CMO or a named spokesperson.

question: When is the post-crisis review completed?
expected_answer: Within 15 working days of standing down.

question: What are the office access hours?
expected_answer: 07:00 to 22:00 on working days; other times need manager approval at least 1 working day in advance.

question: How do I register a visitor?
expected_answer: In the visitor management system by 18:00 on the working day before the visit.

question: Can visitors walk around on their own?
expected_answer: No. Visitors must be escorted by their host at all times in non-public areas.

question: How long is CCTV footage kept?
expected_answer: 30 days, unless needed for an investigation.

question: How often are evacuation drills held?
expected_answer: Twice a year at each office.

question: When can I book a company cab home?
expected_answer: When leaving after 21:00; women employees leaving after 20:00 receive a cab with a security escort or verified driver.

question: How soon must I report an accident?
expected_answer: Within 24 hours, through HelpPoint.

question: Which document should I follow if two documents disagree?
expected_answer: Apply the precedence rules: law first, then only approved documents, then higher level, then more specific, then later effective date.

question: Is a draft or superseded document ever authoritative?
expected_answer: No.

question: Can a local manager's memo change a company policy?
expected_answer: No. Only an approved addendum published by the policy's approver can create a local variation.

question: How often are documents reviewed?
expected_answer: At least every 12 months; low-risk guides and FAQs every 24 months.

question: How quickly are reported conflicts fixed?
expected_answer: Acknowledged within 5 working days and resolved within 30 days.

question: What are CTR documents?
expected_answer: Labelled contradiction examples used to test conflict detection; they are never authoritative.

question: How long are superseded documents kept?
expected_answer: 7 years after supersession.

question: I want to take earned leave from Monday 10 August to Friday 14 August. By when must I apply, and who decides?
expected_answer: This is 5 working days of earned leave, so you must apply in PeopleHub at least 7 calendar days before it starts (by 3 August). Your reporting manager must approve or decline within 2 working days, otherwise it escalates to the skip-level manager.

question: I stayed two nights in a Mumbai hotel at Rs 7,000 per night because the Pune office memo allows Rs 7,500. How much will be reimbursed?
expected_answer: Rs 6,000 per night (Rs 12,000 in total), because Mumbai is a metro city and the approved limit is Rs 6,000. The Pune memo (CTR-002) is unofficial and cannot change company policy. The extra Rs 1,000 per night could only have been reimbursed with department-head pre-approval of an exception.

question: My laptop hasn't arrived yet. A team wiki says I can use my own laptop for email in the first week. Is that allowed?
expected_answer: No. Personal laptops and tablets must not be used to access company systems. Your laptop should be ready on day 1; if it is not, IT provides a loaner. The wiki page (CTR-005) is unofficial.

question: I need a contractor for 4 months at Rs 1,50,000 per month. What approvals and sourcing steps apply?
expected_answer: The total contract value is Rs 6,00,000, so the Finance Controller approves (Rs 5,00,001 to Rs 25,00,000). Raise a purchase request in BuyRight; three quotes are required because the value is above Rs 2,00,000; Legal reviews the contract because it is above Rs 5,00,000; a PO must be issued before work starts; the contractor signs the NDA; and a vendor security assessment is needed if Confidential or Restricted data will be accessed.

question: A supplier emails asking us to pay into a new bank account. What should Accounts Payable do?
expected_answer: Verify by calling back a known contact number from the supplier master record, never a number in the request. A second person in Finance must approve the change before the next payment. If the request is fraudulent, report it as a security incident.

question: We want to offer a candidate a CTC above the band midpoint but below the maximum. Who approves, and how long does the candidate have to accept?
expected_answer: The CHRO approves offers above the midpoint up to the maximum. The candidate has 5 working days to accept.

question: Marketing wants to sponsor an industry event for Rs 8,00,000 that is not in the budget. Who approves?
expected_answer: The Finance Controller (Rs 5,00,001 to Rs 25,00,000), who must also confirm funding because it is unbudgeted spend above Rs 5,00,000. If a customer, prospect or public official is involved in organising the event, Legal and Compliance also reviews it.

question: We plan an AI feature that summarises support tickets containing personal data. What must happen before launch?
expected_answer: A privacy impact assessment must be completed and approved by the Data Protection Officer before launch; new uses of AI involving personal data always require one.

question: A contractor needs access to a dataset containing customer identity numbers. What approvals are needed?
expected_answer: The data is Restricted, so in addition to manager and system-owner approval, Security must approve, and contractors may not access Restricted data without CISO approval.

question: I clicked a link in a phishing email and typed my password. What should I do, and will I be disciplined?
expected_answer: Call the IT hotline immediately. Security will disable your sessions and reset your password; this is typically a SEV-2 incident. Prompt reporting of a genuine mistake is never disciplined.

question: How long is probation? A wiki page says it is only 3 months.
expected_answer: Probation lasts 6 months and may be extended once by up to 3 months (maximum 9 months). The wiki page (CTR-005) is unofficial and not authoritative.

question: An employee has been absent for 3 working days without contacting anyone. What steps should HR follow?
expected_answer: On day 3 the manager calls and messages and HR emails the personal address; on day 5 HR sends a written notice to the home address asking the employee to report or explain within 3 working days; if there is no response, HR may treat it as serious misconduct. HR first checks for a genuine emergency.

question: My flight to Frankfurt is about 9 hours. Can I fly business class?
expected_answer: Possibly. Business class is allowed only for flights longer than 8 hours and only with CFO approval, in addition to your department head's approval of the international trip.

question: A corporate card statement dated 5 March has not been reconciled. When will the card be suspended?
expected_answer: If it is not reconciled within 30 days of the statement date, i.e. by 4 April, the card is suspended until reconciliation is completed. Reconciliation is due within 10 days of the statement date.

question: I received a Rs 1,00,000 relocation lump sum and the company paid Rs 1,20,000 to movers. If I resign after 9 completed months, how much must I repay?
expected_answer: Rs 2,20,000 x (12 - 9) / 12 = Rs 55,000, recovered from the final settlement.

question: A customer is asking for a 25% discount. Who must approve it?
expected_answer: The CFO, because 25% falls in the 20.1% to 30% band.

question: A vendor sent me headphones worth Rs 9,000 after a contract renewal. Can I keep them?
expected_answer: No. Gifts above Rs 3,000 must be declined or handed to HR for the gift register.

question: A prospect unsubscribed from our newsletter on Monday morning. By when must it take effect?
expected_answer: Within 48 hours, so by Wednesday morning.

question: The VPN fails at 09:20 and 300 remote users are affected. What priority is this and what are the targets?
expected_answer: P1: first response by 09:35 (15 minutes) and resolution targeted by 13:20 (4 hours), with updates in the incident channel every 30 minutes.

question: A manager wants to extend a new hire's probation in month 5, but no concerns were documented by month 4. Can they?
expected_answer: Not on that basis. Concerns that may lead to extension must be documented by the end of month 4; concerns raised for the first time at the confirmation review cannot by themselves justify ending employment, and an extension requires concerns documented by month 4.

question: Do I need to change my password every 90 days?
expected_answer: No. There is no forced periodic change; change it immediately only if you suspect compromise. The 90-day rule came from the superseded 2022 standard (CTR-003).

question: A draft procurement note says three quotes are needed above Rs 1,00,000. Do I need three quotes for a Rs 1,50,000 purchase?
expected_answer: No. The approved rule requires three quotes only above Rs 2,00,000, so one quote is enough. The draft note (CTR-004) is not authoritative.

question: I found a leave policy saying employees get 15 days of earned leave. Is that right?
expected_answer: No. The current Leave and Holidays Policy gives 18 days of earned leave per year. The 15-day document is the superseded version 3.0 (CTR-001).

question: Flooding has closed the Bengaluru office. How quickly must employees be notified and checked on?
expected_answer: Employees receive a notification within 30 minutes of the Crisis Management Team deciding it is needed, and HR follows up with anyone who has not confirmed they are safe within 2 hours.

question: Can I approve my own travel expense claim since I am a manager?
expected_answer: No. Nobody may approve their own expense, purchase, travel or pay change.

question: Can I work from Singapore for three days while on holiday there?
expected_answer: Only with prior written approval from HR, Finance and IT Security; your manager cannot approve it alone. Without approval those days must be taken as leave.

question: An employee's Rs 65,000 certification was company-funded and they resign 6 months after completing it. How much do they repay?
expected_answer: Because it cost more than Rs 50,000, the learning agreement applies: repay 6/12 of Rs 65,000 = Rs 32,500.

question: We want to host officials from a state-owned bank for a product demo and lunch. Is that allowed?
expected_answer: Yes, but only with prior written approval from the Head of Legal and Compliance, because state-owned bank staff are public officials under the policy.

question: When must customer data be deleted after a contract ends?
expected_answer: Within 90 days of contract end, unless the contract says otherwise.

question: What are the steps to request access to a new system?
expected_answer: Raise a request in HelpPoint > Request Access with the business reason; your manager approves first, then the system owner; Restricted data also needs Security approval; IT then grants access to you as a named individual.
